author: Dale Philip
description:
I visited a restaurant in South Jakarta that specializes in Unagi, one of my most favourite Japanese foods.

The XL Unaju at 'Unagi Kurofune' restaurant is a charcoal-grilled freshwater eel (unagi) glazed with a sweet and savory soy-based sauce (tare) and served over hot rice inside a rectangular lacquered box called a jubako.

The meal was about $25 USD, which is pretty reasonable.
title: Delicious Butter Unagi in Jakarta, Indonesia 🇮🇩
